verdict.rationale: DPMA's online services, such as the DEPATISnet search database, DPMAregister and the DPMAdirektWeb/Pro e-filing tools, could plausibly include an AI assistant, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a built-in AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. The only help offered is a human initial consultation at the Munich and Berlin enquiry units, which does not count toward this story.
